approval_challenges_consumption_valid.name: approval_challenges_consumption_valid
approval_challenges_consumption_valid.value:
("approval_challenges"."state" = 'CONSUMED' and "approval_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null and "approval_challenges"."consumed_at" >= "approval_challenges"."created_at") or
        ("approval_challenges"."state" != 'CONSUMED' and "approval_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)

audit_events_previous_hash_valid.name: audit_events_previous_hash_valid
audit_events_previous_hash_valid.value: "audit_events"."previous_event_hash" is null or (length("audit_events"."previous_event_hash") = 64 and "audit_events"."previous_event_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

audit_events_chain_root_valid.name: audit_events_chain_root_valid
audit_events_chain_root_valid.value:
("audit_events"."sequence" = 0 and "audit_events"."previous_event_hash" is null) or
        ("audit_events"."sequence" > 0 and "audit_events"."previous_event_hash" is not null)

idempotency_records_response_state_valid.name: idempotency_records_response_state_valid
idempotency_records_response_state_valid.value:
("idempotency_records"."state" = 'PENDING' and "idempotency_records"."response_status" is null and "idempotency_records"."response_body" is null) or
        ("idempotency_records"."state" != 'PENDING' and "idempotency_records"."response_status" is not null and "idempotency_records"."response_body" is not null)

merchant_verifications_result_valid.name: merchant_verifications_result_valid
merchant_verifications_result_valid.value: ("merchant_verifications"."status" = 'PASS' and "merchant_verifications"."reason" is null) or ("merchant_verifications"."status" = 'FAIL' and "merchant_verifications"."reason" is not null)

merchants_verification_expiry_valid.name: merchants_verification_expiry_valid
merchants_verification_expiry_valid.value: "merchants"."verification_expires_at" is null or ("merchants"."last_verification_at" is not null and "merchants"."verification_expires_at" > "merchants"."last_verification_at")

organizations_slug_format.name: organizations_slug_format
organizations_slug_format.value:
length("organizations"."slug") between 3 and 63 and
        "organizations"."slug" = lower("organizations"."slug") and
        "organizations"."slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and
        substr("organizations"."slug", 1, 1) != '-' and
        substr("organizations"."slug", -1, 1) != '-'
